rules.title: Just Cause for Eviction Ordinance (JCO)
rules.requirement: Landlords of rental units not covered by the Rent Stabilization Ordinance must have a legally recognized just cause to terminate a tenancy, and must pay relocation assistance for no-fault evictions after the tenant has lived in the unit at least six months or their lease has expired.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to most residential rental properties in the City of Los Angeles not regulated by the RSO, including properties newer than October 1, 1978, once the tenant has occupied the unit for at least six months or the original lease has expired.
rules.exemptions: Transient hotels, licensed care facilities, fraternity/sorority houses, owner's roommate situations, certain cooperatives, some non-profit homeless or substance-abuse treatment facilities, and some HACLA or government-owned properties are excepted.
rules.penalty: Failure to file the Landlord Declaration with the LAHD makes the eviction a violation of the RSO or JCO.
rules.quoted_span: It prohibits terminations of tenancies without just cause and requires relocation assistance for no-fault evictions.

coverage.other_unknown_factor: whether the unit is already regulated under the Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO)

rules.title: Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO) – Just Cause Eviction Provisions
rules.requirement: For units covered by the RSO (generally buildings first built on or before October 1, 1978), landlords may only terminate a tenancy for specific at-fault or no-fault reasons listed in the ordinance, with no-fault evictions requiring payment of relocation assistance and filing of required notices with LAHD.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to rental properties first built on or before October 1, 1978 (and certain replacement units under LAMC 151.28), including apartments, condos/townhomes (for tenancies before 1996), duplexes, multiple single-family units on one parcel, long-term hotel/rooming house rooms, ADUs/JADUs, and mobile homes/RVs in mobile home parks.
rules.exemptions: Condominiums and townhomes are not rent-regulated for tenancies commencing after December 31, 1995; other exemptions may apply under LAMC 151.
rules.penalty: Failure to file the Landlord Declaration with the LAHD makes the eviction a violation of the RSO or JCO.
rules.quoted_span: No-fault evictions require the payment of relocation assistance.

coverage.other_unknown_factor: property type (apartment, condo/townhome tenancy start date, duplex, mobile home, etc.) as defined by RSO coverage rules
